title: एकत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: The Matsyas overtake the Trigartas at sunset and a fierce battle begins. The earth is strewn with severed arms and heads, and in the rising dust the two armies can no longer tell friend from foe.
summary.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ಸ್ಯರು ತ್ರಿಗರ್ತರನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಭೀಕರ ಯುದ್ಧ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಭೂಮಿ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿದ ತೋಳು ತಲೆಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬುತ್ತದೆ; ಏಳುವ ಧೂಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡೂ ಸೈನ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಿತ್ರ ಶತ್ರು ಭೇದ ತಿಳಿಯದಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: सूर्यास्त के समय मत्स्य त्रिगर्तों को जा पकड़ते हैं और भयंकर युद्ध आरम्भ होता है। पृथ्वी कटी भुजाओं और सिरों से भर जाती है, और उठती धूल में दोनों सेनाएँ मित्र और शत्रु में भेद नहीं कर पातीं।
summary.te: సూర్యాస్తమయంలో మత్స్యులు త్రిగర్తులను అందుకుంటారు, భీకర యుద్ధం మొదలవుతుంది. భూమి తెగిన చేతులు, తలలతో నిండిపోతుంది; లేచే ధూళిలో రెండు సైన్యాలకూ మిత్రులెవరో శత్రువులెవరో తెలియకుండా పోతుంది.
summary.ta: சூரியன் மறையும்போது மத்ஸ்யர்கள் த்ரிகர்த்தர்களை எட்டிப் பிடிக்க, கடும் போர் தொடங்குகிறது. வெட்டப்பட்ட கைகளாலும் தலைகளாலும் பூமி நிறைய, எழும் புழுதியில் இரு படைகளும் நண்பனையும் பகைவனையும் பிரித்தறிய முடியவில்லை.
summary.ml: സൂര്യാസ്തമയ സമയത്ത് മത്സ്യർ ത്രിഗർത്തരെ പിടികൂടി ഘോരയുദ്ധം തുടങ്ങുന്നു. ഭൂമി മുറിഞ്ഞ കൈകാലുകളും തലകളും കൊണ്ട് നിറയുന്നു; ഉയരുന്ന പൊടിയിൽ ഇരുസേനകൾക്കും മിത്രത്തെയും ശത്രുവിനെയും തിരിച്ചറിയാൻ കഴിയാതാകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 4.31; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Dec  1 2011

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
निर्याय नगराच्छूरा व्यूढानीकाः प्रहारिणः ।
त्रिगर्तानस्पृशन्मत्स्याः सूर्ये परिणते सति ॥

meaning.en: Marching out of the city in battle array, the brave Matsya fighters reached the Trigartas as the sun began to sink.

verses.text:
ते त्रिगर्ताश्च मत्स्याश्च संरब्धा युद्धदुर्मदाः ।
अन्योन्यमभिगर्जन्तो गोषु गृद्धा महाबलाः ॥

meaning.en: The Trigartas and the Matsyas, mighty and fierce, wild for battle and greedy for the cattle, roared at each other.

verses.text:
भीमाश्च मत्तमातङ्गास्तोमराङ्कुशचोदिताः ।
ग्रामणीयैः समारूढाः कुशलैर्हस्तिसादिभिः ॥

meaning.en: The terrible rutting elephants, goaded with lances and hooks, were mounted by skilled riders who led them forward.

verses.text:
तेषां समागमो घोरस्तुमुलो लोमहर्षणः ।
देवासुरसमो राजन्नासीत्सूर्ये विलम्बति ॥

meaning.en: Their clash was dreadful, tumultuous and hair-raising, king, like that of gods and demons, while the sun lingered.

verses.text:
उदतिष्ठद्रजो भौमं न प्रज्ञायत किंचन ।
पक्षिणश्चापतन्भूमौ सैन्येन रजसावृताः ॥

meaning.en: Dust rose from the ground and nothing could be made out; birds, smothered in the army's dust, fell to the earth.

verses.text:
इषुभिर्व्यतिसंयद्भिरादित्योऽन्तरधीयत ।
खद्योतैरिव संयुक्तमन्तरिक्षं व्यराजत ॥

meaning.en: With arrows flying across each other the sun was hidden, and the sky shone as if full of fireflies.

verses.text:
रुक्मपृष्ठानि चापानि व्यतिषक्तानि धन्विनाम् ।
पततां लोकवीराणां सव्यदक्षिणमस्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: The gold-backed bows of the archers, those world-famous heroes, fell tangled together as they shot to left and right.

verses.text:
रथा रथैः समाजग्मुः पादातैश्च पदातयः ।
सादिभिः सादिनश्चैव गजैश्चापि महागजाः ॥

meaning.en: Chariots met chariots, foot soldiers met foot soldiers, horsemen met horsemen, and great elephants met elephants.

verses.text:
असिभिः पट्टिशैः प्रासैः शक्तिभिस्तोमरैरपि ।
संरब्धाः समरे राजन्निजघ्नुरितरेतरम् ॥

meaning.en: O king, they struck one another in rage with swords, clubs, spears, javelins and lances.

verses.text:
निघ्नन्तः समरेऽन्योन्यं शूराः परिघबाहवः ।
न शेकुरभिसंरब्धाः शूरान्कर्तुं पराङ्मुखान् ॥

meaning.en: Those heroes with arms like iron bars killed each other in battle, yet in their fury none could make the others turn their backs.

verses.text:
कॢप्तोत्तरोष्ठं सुनसं कॢप्तकेशमलंकृतम् ।
अदृश्यत शिरश्छिन्नं रजोध्वस्तं सकुण्डलम् ॥

meaning.en: A severed head was seen, with neat upper lip, fine nose and trimmed, adorned hair, still wearing earrings and covered with dust.

verses.text:
अदृश्यंस्तत्र गात्राणि शरैश्छिन्नानि भागशः ।
शालस्कन्धनिकाशानि क्षत्रियाणां महामृधे ॥

meaning.en: Limbs of Kshatriyas, cut to pieces by arrows, were seen in that great slaughter, like trunks of sal trees.

verses.text:
नागभोगनिकाशैश्च बाहुभिश्चन्दनोक्षितैः ।
आकीर्णा वसुधा तत्र शिरोभिश्च सकुण्डलैः ॥

meaning.en: The earth was strewn with arms like serpents' coils, smeared with sandalwood, and with heads in earrings.

verses.text:
उपशाम्यद्रजो भौमं रुधिरेण प्रसर्पता ।
कश्मलं प्राविशद्घोरं निर्मर्यादमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: The dust on the ground settled under the spreading blood; a fearful confusion set in, and all restraint was gone.

verses.text:
शतानीकः शतं हत्वा विशालाक्षश्चतुःशतम् ।
प्रविष्टौ महतीं सेनां त्रिगर्तानां महारथौ ।
आर्च्छेतां बहुसंरब्धौ केशाकेशि नखानखि ॥

meaning.en: Shatanika killed a hundred and Vishalaksha four hundred; both great charioteers plunged into the large Trigarta army and grappled in fury, hair to hair and nail to nail.

verses.text:
लक्षयित्वा त्रिगर्तानां तौ प्रविष्टौ रथव्रजम् ।
जग्मतुः सूर्यदत्तश्च मदिराश्वश्च पृष्ठतः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing those two enter the mass of Trigarta chariots, Suryadatta and Madirashva followed behind them.

verses.text:
विराटस्तत्र संग्रामे हत्वा पञ्चशतान्रथान् ।
हयानां च शतान्यत्र हत्वा पञ्च महारथान् ॥

meaning.en: In that battle Virata killed five hundred chariots, hundreds of horses and five great chariot-fighters.

verses.text:
चरन्स विविधान्मार्गान्रथेषु रथयूथपः ।
त्रिगर्तानां सुशर्माणमार्च्छद्रुक्मरथं रणे ॥

meaning.en: Ranging over many paths among the chariots, that leader of chariot troops met in battle Susharman of the Trigartas, in his golden chariot.

verses.text:
तौ व्यावहरतां तत्र महात्मानौ महाबलौ ।
अन्योन्यमभिगर्जन्तौ गोष्ठे गोवृषभाविव ॥

meaning.en: Those two mighty, great-souled men fought there, roaring at each other like two bulls in a cow pen.

verses.text:
ततो रथाभ्यां रथिनौ व्यतियाय समन्ततः ।
शरान्व्यसृजतां शीघ्रं तोयधारा घनाविव ॥

meaning.en: Then the two charioteers circled all around each other in their chariots and quickly loosed arrows like clouds pouring streams of rain.

verses.text:
अन्योन्यं चातिसंरब्धौ विचेरतुरमर्षणौ ।
कृतास्त्रौ निशितैर्बाणैरसिशक्तिगदाभृतौ ॥

meaning.en: Skilled in weapons, both furious and unforgiving, they moved about with sharp arrows and with swords, spears and clubs in their hands.

verses.text:
ततो राजा सुशर्माणं विव्याध दशभिः शरैः ।
पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिश्चास्य विव्याध चतुरो हयान् ॥

meaning.en: Then the king pierced Susharman with ten arrows and each of his four horses with five.

verses.text:
तथैव मत्स्यराजानं सुशर्मा युद्धदुर्मदः ।
पञ्चाशता शितैर्बाणैर्विव्याध परमास्त्रवित् ॥

meaning.en: In the same way Susharman, wild in battle and a master of great weapons, pierced the king of Matsya with fifty sharp arrows.

verses.text:
ततः सैन्यं समावृत्य मत्स्यराजसुशर्मणोः ।
नाभ्यजानंस्तदान्योन्यं प्रदोषे रजसावृते ॥

meaning.en: Then the armies closed in around Virata and Susharman, and in the dusk and dust they could no longer tell one another apart.
